## Use Kaggle as a lab

Load a real dataset, identify useful features and a target, prepare the data, train a basic model, and evaluate its performance.

## Evaluation matters

Use train and test data, appropriate metrics, and error analysis. Learn why overfitting, weak data, and biased data can produce misleading results.

## Grade 12 extension

Compare models, tune parameters, investigate failures, and, where appropriate, explore a small language model or the way an AI system can use tools and structured data.
